reviews.reasons: NO_PLAN is the right stance and names the decisive gap correctly. The only opening (cop_36668e0f6c6b416fa790) has four signed $1,600 work orders: 4 x $1,600 = $6,400 >= $6,000, cost $700 < price, $0 exposure, 15 days to cash inside 30 — every commercial link holds. But the deliverable is on-site disinfection of a dialysis reverse-osmosis water system plus chemical and bacterial tests: physical, regulated clinical work. The card has no fulfillmentOwner and an empty requiredCapabilities, Brain cannot perform on-site work, and the owner's physical work and qualification are UNSTATED, so FULFILMENT is unestablished (Brain's own link agrees: 'nobody has established who would do the work'). This is missing evidence, correctly recorded as the decisive link rather than as a constraint, and it is not a CONDITIONAL case: who performs the visits is answered by research and a written commitment, not by a live market test, and taking the clinics' money before a performer is named would sell work nobody is shown able to do. The resolution is concrete (a named qualified technician or RO-service company committing in writing to four visits within 15 days at <= $700, paid after each clinic pays, or the owner stating he holds the qualification).
findings: Arithmetic verified: $6,400 gross from four signed orders vs $6,000 target ($400 slack, so all four visits must be completed and paid); $2,800 direct cost leaves $3,600 net, irrelevant to a gross settled-cash target.

The $700 direct cost is not tied to a named provider; when a fulfiller is named, its rate must be <= $700 for the recorded economics to hold, and its payment terms must follow the clinic's payment to keep the $0 exposure cap.
Timing: a fulfiller must complete the four visits early enough that 15 days to cash lands inside day 30, i.e. visits by about day 15.
Ledger is empty, consistent with NO_PLAN; the research step r1 targets exactly the decisive link.
FULFILMENT unestablished: the card records no fulfillmentOwner and no requiredCapabilities for regulated on-site RO disinfection and testing (the decisive link this no-plan already names).
